Its own path, not the `users/me/credentials` one, because the body is different (`token`, and the provider enum is `github`/`gitlab`). The token is encrypted and stored without prior verification (ADR 0050); to verify it, `POST /users/me/credentials/{provider}/test`. Reading, removal, and testing reuse the `users/me/credentials` routes — it's the same table.
